$comment: Administration contracts. All require the Admin policy; a customer receives 403 Forbidden.

semantics.totalSales: sum of Total for orders whose status is not Cancelled (order value, not collected cash)
semantics.averageOrderValue: totalSales / count(non-cancelled), rounded to 2 dp; 0 when there are none
semantics.ordersByStatus: all five keys always present, zero when unused
semantics.lowStockCount: active variants with 0 < stock <= 5 (zero-stock variants are out of stock, not low stock — matches shopLogic.checkStockStatus)
semantics.totalProducts: products whose status is not archived
semantics.collectedRevenue: sum of Total where paymentStatus = Collected

deltaMode.sql: UPDATE ProductVariants SET Stock = Stock + @delta, UpdatedAtUtc = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE Id = @variantId AND Stock + @delta >= 0

rules.audit: every accepted adjustment appends InventoryAdjustments { variantId, delta, previousStock, newStock, reason, actorId, occurredAtUtc }
rules.concurrency: a concurrent checkout deduction is never overwritten silently: absolute mode is version-guarded, delta mode is atomic arithmetic

orderStatus.notes: Shipping or delivering never sets paymentStatus. An illegal transition returns 409 InvalidOrderTransition.

paymentCollect.eligibility: status ∈ { Shipped, Delivered } AND paymentStatus = Unpaid
paymentCollect.replay: same amount again → 200 with the existing record; different amount → 409 PaymentConflict
paymentCollect.blocked: status Pending → 409 PaymentNotEligible; collected then cancel → 409 PaymentCollectedCannotCancel

list.notes: status accepts published | archived | all. This is the only place archived products are visible.

rules.defaultVariant: a product always has at least one purchasable variant; when no options exist it is the single default variant
rules.brand: must resolve to an existing brand (slug or exact name); unknown brand → 400 ValidationFailed on 'brand'
rules.price: variant price is authoritative; the product price is the displayed 'from' price

request.$comment: Full replace of supplied fields. Variants are matched by id; omitted variants are preserved, never deleted implicitly. Explicit removal requires isActive=false.

archive.notes: Archival, never deletion: historical orders keep resolving product and variant ids.

imageUpload.request: multipart/form-data; the first file part is the file

rules.validation: magic-byte content sniffing, allow-list image/jpeg|image/png|image/webp, max 5 MB (a rule of the code, not a setting)
rules.naming: server-generated 32-hex name + extension from the sniffed type; the client filename is kept only as 'fileName' (cleaned) in the record and the download name, never as a path
rules.serving: public, static files under FileStorage:PublicBasePath (default /media) from FileStorage:RootPath\images only; path traversal rejected
rules.storage: IFileStorage / LocalFileStorage write under FileStorage:RootPath\images (folder name FileStorage:ImagesFolder) and survive restart; one record per file in document.StoredFiles (Kind, OriginalName, StoredName, ContentType, SizeBytes, UploadedBy, UploadedAtUtc), no path stored

errors.400: ValidationFailed (type/size/no file/not multipart): reason in errors.file and in detail
errors.413: PayloadTooLarge (body above the 10 MB host limit)

imageUpload.notes: Replaces POST /api/v1/admin/images (response was { url }); the old route no longer exists and answers the generic 404.

documentUpload.request: multipart/form-data; the first file part is the file

rules.validation: content decides the type: PDF, Word .docx, Excel .xlsx, CSV or plain text; max 8 MB (a rule of the code, not a setting)
rules.naming: server-generated name; the client filename is kept only as 'fileName' (cleaned) in the record and the download name
rules.serving: never a public file: 'url' is the administrator-only download address GET /api/v1/files/{id}
rules.storage: FileStorage:RootPath\documents (folder name FileStorage:DocumentsFolder); one record per file in document.StoredFiles

errors.400: ValidationFailed (type/size/no file/not multipart): reason in errors.file and in detail
errors.413: PayloadTooLarge (body above the 10 MB host limit)

fileDownload.response200: the file's bytes (image or document) as an attachment under the name it was uploaded with, with its real content type and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff

errors.404: NotFound (unknown id, or the file has gone missing from disk)

rules.validation: value > 0; percentage ≤ 100; minOrderAmount ≥ 0; expiry in the future

archive.notes: Sets active=false. Rows and redemptions are retained so historical orders keep their discountCode.

list.notes: Includes inactive banners; the public endpoint returns active only.

rules.replace: the supplied array is the complete set; ids present in the request are updated, new ids created, and rows absent from the request are deactivated (never deleted)
rules.localization: all four localized fields keep both en and ar
